verdict.rationale: The docs say a notebook can be made public and shared by link with anyone who has a Google account, and paid owners get usage analytics on public notebooks; a runtime probe confirms the public-notebooks help page is live. For building on the work, notes can be exported to Google Docs/Sheets and slide decks can be presented or shared as PDF. Missing for 10: evidence of per-collaborator sharing with edit or contributor permissions (co-editing a notebook), private (non-public) sharing controls, and independent hands-on corroboration of the sharing workflow.
